## Background

Texas experienced severe winter storms in February 2021, causing a loss of power infrastructure and impacting homes in the Houston area. Being on an independent grid, Texas is unable to import energy from neighboring states at large scales when their power infrastructure goes down. For this assignment, Visible Infrared Imaging Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) data is used, which contains measurements of nighttime brightness, looking at the dates February 7, 2021, and February 16, 2021. 

## Loading Packages 

```{r}
#| output: False 

library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(raster)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)
```


```{r}
vnp_feb7a<- rast(here(
  "data", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif"))

vnp_feb7b <- rast(here(
  "data", "VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif"))

vnp_feb16a <- rast(here(
  "data", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif"))

vnp_feb16b <- rast(here(
  "data", "VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif"))

roads <- read_sf('data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg')
buildings <- read_sf('data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg')
```

## Data Merging 

```{r}
same.crs(vnp_feb7a, vnp_feb7b)
same.crs(vnp_feb16a, vnp_feb16b)
```

```{r}
vnp_feb7 <- terra::merge(vnp_feb7a, vnp_feb7b)
vnp_feb16 <- terra::merge(vnp_feb16a, vnp_feb16b)
```

## Create Blackout Mask 
```{r}
# Finding the difference in light intensity, Subtracting Feb 16 from Feb 7  
difference <- vnp_feb7 - vnp_feb16

# Peint a summary of the raster
print(difference)
```

```{r}
# Reclassify the matrix 
rclassify <-  matrix(c(
    -Inf, 200, NA, # not likely a blackout 
    200, Inf, 1), # more likely to be a blackout 
    ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE) # three column matrix, one row 

reclassified <- terra::classify(difference, rcl = rclassify, right = TRUE)
```

```{r}
blackout_vector <- terra::as.polygons(reclassified, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
blackout_polygons <- sf::st_as_sf(blackout_vector)
print(blackout_polygons)
```

```{r}
blackout_polygons <- sf::st_make_valid(blackout_polygons)
```


```{r}
# Creating a bounding box for Houston 
houston_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(xmin = -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
  crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
)

# making the bounding box into a polygon
houston_box <- sf::st_as_sfc(houston_bbox)
```


```{r}
# Matching the bbox to the crs 
houston_box <- st_transform(houston_box, st_crs(blackout_polygons))

# keep only the blackout geometries 

blackout_crop <- st_intersection(st_geometry(blackout_polygons), houston_box)
```


```{r}
# Reprojection 
blackout_houston <- st_sf(geometry = st_transform(blackout_crop, crs = 3083))

crs(blackout_houston)
```

## Exclude highways from the cropped blackout mask 
```{r}
# Identify areas within 200m of all highways 

roads <- st_transform(subset(roads, fclass == "motorway"), crs = 3083)

roads_buffer <- st_union(st_buffer(roads, dist = 200))

```


```{r}
# find areas that experienced blackouts that are further than 200m from a highway 

outside_200m <- st_sf(geometry = st_difference(
  st_geometry(blackout_houston), roads_buffer))
```

## Identify the number of homes likely impacted by blackouts 
```{r}
# identify homes that overlap with areas that experienced blackouts 
buildings <- st_transform(buildings, crs = 3083)
```

```{r}
blackout_homes <- st_filter(buildings, outside_200m)
print(nrow(blackout_homes))
```

## Viusalization 

```{r}
tmap_mode("plot")

tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap")
tm_shape(outside_200m) +
tm_polygons(fill = "lightblue") +
tm_shape(blackout_homes) +
tm_polygons(fill = "blue") +
tm_scalebar(position = c("left", "bottom")) +
tm_compass(position = c("right", "top")) +
tm_title("Houston homes affected by blackouts in February 2021")
```
